- Authenticated Key System (Key: kararoottoo) with Direct Discord Link Copy
- Custom Floating Shift Lock Icon (Touch Draggable for Mobile & PC)
- Embellished Developer Overhead Title Tag over Character Head

script:
--[[
    ✨ Aether Hub V31.0 | Brookhaven RP
    Developed by & for @kararoottoo
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- 1. كتابة الاسم والمطور فوق الرأس
local function createOverheadTitle()
    pcall(function()
        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") then
            local head = LocalPlayer.Character.Head
            if head:FindFirstChild("AetherOverhead") then head.AetherOverhead:Destroy() end

            local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
            billboard.Name = "AetherOverhead"
            billboard.Adornee = head
            billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
            billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
            billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
            billboard.Parent = head

            local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
            titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            titleLabel.Text = "✨ Aether Hub V31.0 ✨"
            titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170)
            titleLabel.TextSize = 16
            titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
            titleLabel.Parent = billboard

            local devLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
            devLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
            devLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
            devLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            devLabel.Text = "المطور: 👑 كـ,ـرآر | kـ,ـآرآرﯛتـ,ـو 👑"
            devLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
            devLabel.TextSize = 13
            devLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
            devLabel.Parent = billboard
        end
    end)
end

-- 2. واجهة اختيار اللغة
local LangGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
LangGui.Name = "AetherLangSelectV31"
LangGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
LangGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local LangFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
LangFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 310, 0, 180)
LangFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -155, 0.4, -90)
LangFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26)
LangFrame.Active = true
LangFrame.Draggable = true
LangFrame.Parent = LangGui

Instance.new("UICorner", LangFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
local LangStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", LangFrame)
LangStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
LangStroke.Thickness = 2

local LangTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
LangTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
LangTitle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 36)
LangTitle.Text = "🌐 اختر اللغة / Select Language"
LangTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
LangTitle.TextSize = 16
LangTitle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
LangTitle.Parent = LangFrame
Instance.new("UICorner", LangTitle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

local BtnAr = Instance.new("TextButton")
BtnAr.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 0, 45)
BtnAr.Position = UDim2.new(0.06, 0, 0.5, 0)
BtnAr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
BtnAr.Text = "العربية 🇸🇦"
BtnAr.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
BtnAr.TextSize = 16
BtnAr.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
BtnAr.Parent = LangFrame

local BtnEn = Instance.new("TextButton")
BtnEn.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 0, 45)
BtnEn.Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 0.5, 0)
BtnEn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 52)
BtnEn.Text = "English 🇺🇸"
BtnEn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
BtnEn.TextSize = 16
BtnEn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
BtnEn.Parent = LangFrame

Instance.new("UICorner", BtnAr).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
Instance.new("UICorner", BtnEn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

local selectedLang = "AR"

-- 3. واجهة نظام المفتاح والـ Rayfield
local function openKeySystem()
    LangGui:Destroy()
    createOverheadTitle()
    LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(createOverheadTitle)

    local KeyGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    KeyGui.Name = "AetherKeySystemV31"
    KeyGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    KeyGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

    local KeyFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
    KeyFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 220)
    KeyFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.35, -110)
    KeyFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26)
    KeyFrame.Active = true
    KeyFrame.Draggable = true
    KeyFrame.Parent = KeyGui

    Instance.new("UICorner", KeyFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)
    local KeyStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", KeyFrame)
    KeyStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170)
    KeyStroke.Thickness = 2

    local KeyTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    KeyTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 42)
    KeyTitle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 36)
    KeyTitle.Text = selectedLang == "AR" and "🔑 أدخل رمز الدخول | Key System" or "🔑 Enter Key System | V31.0"
    KeyTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170)
    KeyTitle.TextSize = 16
    KeyTitle.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    KeyTitle.Parent = KeyFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", KeyTitle).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 12)

    local KeyInput = Instance.new("TextBox")
    KeyInput.Size = UDim2.new(0.86, 0, 0, 40)
    KeyInput.Position = UDim2.new(0.07, 0, 0.28, 0)
    KeyInput.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)
    KeyInput.PlaceholderText = selectedLang == "AR" and "اكتب الرمز هنا..." or "Type Key Here..."
    KeyInput.Text = ""
    KeyInput.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    KeyInput.TextSize = 14
    KeyInput.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
    KeyInput.Parent = KeyFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", KeyInput).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local SubmitBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    SubmitBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.41, 0, 0, 40)
    SubmitBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.07, 0, 0.52, 0)
    SubmitBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170)
    SubmitBtn.Text = selectedLang == "AR" and "تفعيل ⚡" or "Submit ⚡"
    SubmitBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 26)
    SubmitBtn.TextSize = 15
    SubmitBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    SubmitBtn.Parent = KeyFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", SubmitBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local DiscordBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    DiscordBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.42, 0, 0, 40)
    DiscordBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.51, 0, 0.52, 0)
    DiscordBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
    DiscordBtn.Text = selectedLang == "AR" and "نسخ الديسكورد 💬" or "Copy Discord 💬"
    DiscordBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    DiscordBtn.TextSize = 14
    DiscordBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    DiscordBtn.Parent = KeyFrame
    Instance.new("UICorner", DiscordBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

    local StatusLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    StatusLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.86, 0, 0, 25)
    StatusLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.07, 0, 0.78, 0)
    StatusLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    StatusLabel.Text = selectedLang == "AR" and "الرمز المعتمد: kararoottoo" or "Key is: kararoottoo"
    StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
    StatusLabel.TextSize = 12
    StatusLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansItalic
    StatusLabel.Parent = KeyFrame

    DiscordBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setclipboard("https://discord.gg/WTmsZWHAB")
        StatusLabel.Text = selectedLang == "AR" and "تم نسخ رابط الديسكورد! ✅" or "Discord Link Copied! ✅"
        StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    end)

    SubmitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local inputKey = KeyInput.Text
        if inputKey == "kararoottoo" or inputKey == "AETHER-2026" or inputKey == "STAFF_BYPASS_AETHER_2026" or inputKey == "V31" then
            KeyGui:Destroy()

            -- 4. تحميل الواجهة المباشرة
            local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

            local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "✨ Aether Hub V31.0" or "✨ Aether Hub V31.0",
               Icon = 4483362458,
               LoadingTitle = "Aether Hub V31.0 Loading...",
               LoadingSubtitle = "by @kararoottoo",
               ConfigurationSaving = { Enabled = false },
               KeySystem = false
            })

            -- Tab 1: الرئيسية
            local MainTab = Window:CreateTab(selectedLang == "AR" and "الرئيسية 🏃" or "Main 🏃", 4483362458)

            MainTab:CreateSlider({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "WalkSpeed / السرعة" or "WalkSpeed",
               Range = {16, 500},
               Increment = 1,
               Suffix = "Speed",
               CurrentValue = 16,
               Callback = function(Value)
                   if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                       LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = Value
                   end
               end,
            })

            MainTab:CreateSlider({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "JumpPower / القفز" or "JumpPower",
               Range = {50, 500},
               Increment = 5,
               Suffix = "Power",
               CurrentValue = 50,
               Callback = function(Value)
                   if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
                       LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = Value
                   end
               end,
            })

            MainTab:CreateSlider({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "الجاذبية / Gravity" or "Gravity",
               Range = {0, 196},
               Increment = 1,
               Suffix = "Gravity",
               CurrentValue = 196,
               Callback = function(Value)
                   workspace.Gravity = Value
               end,
            })

            local noclipConn = nil
            MainTab:CreateToggle({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "اختراق الجدران / Noclip 👻" or "Noclip 👻",
               CurrentValue = false,
               Callback = function(Value)
                   if Value then
                       noclipConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
                           if LocalPlayer.Character then
                               for _, part in pairs(LocalPlayer.Character:GetDescendants()) do
                                   if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
                               end
                           end
                       end)
                   else
                       if noclipConn then noclipConn:Disconnect() noclipConn = nil end
                   end
               end,
            })

            MainTab:CreateSlider({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "منظور الكاميرا / Camera FOV 🎥" or "Camera FOV 🎥",
               Range = {70, 120},
               Increment = 1,
               Suffix = "FOV",
               CurrentValue = 70,
               Callback = function(Value)
                   Camera.FieldOfView = Value
               end,
            })

            -- Tab 2: الأدوات الإضافية
            local PowerTab = Window:CreateTab(selectedLang == "AR" and "الأدوات ⚡" or "Tools ⚡", 4483362458)

            local infJumpConn = nil
            PowerTab:CreateToggle({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "القفز اللانهائي / Infinite Jump 🚀" or "Infinite Jump 🚀",
               CurrentValue = false,
               Callback = function(Value)
                   if Value then
                       infJumpConn = UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
                           if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
                               LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState("Jumping")
                           end
                       end)
                   else
                       if infJumpConn then infJumpConn:Disconnect() infJumpConn = nil end
                   end
               end,
            })

            -- Tab 3: الاستهداف
            local PlayerTab = Window:CreateTab(selectedLang == "AR" and "الاستهداف واللاعب 🎯" or "Target & Player 🎯", 4483362458)

            local selectedTarget = nil
            local playerNames = {}

            for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= LocalPlayer then
                    table.insert(playerNames, p.DisplayName .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")")
                end
            end

            PlayerTab:CreateDropdown({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "تحديد لاعب للاستهداف 👤" or "Select Target 👤",
               Options = playerNames,
               CurrentOption = "",
               MultipleOptions = false,
               Callback = function(Option)
                   local selectedString = type(Option) == "table" and Option[1] or Option
                   for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                       if p.DisplayName .. " (@" .. p.Name .. ")" == selectedString then
                           selectedTarget = p
                           break
                       end
                   end
               end,
            })

            PlayerTab:CreateButton({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "الانتقال خلف اللاعب (TP Behind) ⚡" or "Teleport Behind ⚡",
               Callback = function()
                   if selectedTarget and selectedTarget.Character and selectedTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                       if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                           LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = selectedTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                       end
                   end
               end,
            })

            local followConn = nil
            PlayerTab:CreateToggle({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "ملاحقة اللاعب تلقائياً / Auto Follow 🧲" or "Auto Follow 🧲",
               CurrentValue = false,
               Callback = function(Value)
                   if Value then
                       if selectedTarget then
                           followConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                               if selectedTarget and selectedTarget.Character and selectedTarget.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                                   if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                                       LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = selectedTarget.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                                   end
                               end
                           end)
                       end
                   else
                       if followConn then followConn:Disconnect() followConn = nil end
                   end
               end,
            })

            -- Tab 4: نسخ السكنات
            local CopyTab = Window:CreateTab(selectedLang == "AR" and "نسخ السكنات 🤖" or "Outfit Stealer 🤖", 4483362458)

            local targetPlayer = nil

            CopyTab:CreateInput({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "اسم اللاعب (أول الحروف)" or "Player Username (Prefix)",
               PlaceholderText = "Username...",
               RemoveTextAfterFocusLost = false,
               Callback = function(Text)
                   local input = string.lower(Text)
                   targetPlayer = nil
                   if input ~= "" then
                       for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                           if p ~= LocalPlayer then
                               if string.sub(string.lower(p.Name), 1, #input) == input or string.sub(string.lower(p.DisplayName), 1, #input) == input then
                                   targetPlayer = p
                                   break
                               end
                           end
                       end
                   end
               end,
            })

            CopyTab:CreateButton({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "نسخ السكن والجسم بالكامل ⚡" or "Steal Full Body & Outfit ⚡",
               Callback = function()
                   if not targetPlayer or not targetPlayer.Character then return end

                   local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                   local targetChar = targetPlayer.Character

                   if myChar and targetChar then
                       for _, item in pairs(myChar:GetChildren()) do
                           if item:IsA("Shirt") or item:IsA("Pants") or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or item:IsA("Accessory") or item:IsA("BodyColors") or item:IsA("CharacterMesh") then
                               item:Destroy()
                           end
                       end

                       pcall(function()
                           local clearRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RE", true) and ReplicatedStorage.RE:FindFirstChild("ClearOutfit", true)
                           if clearRemote then clearRemote:FireServer() end
                       end)

                       for _, item in pairs(targetChar:GetChildren()) do
                           if item:IsA("CharacterMesh") or item:IsA("Shirt") or item:IsA("Pants") or item:IsA("ShirtGraphic") or item:IsA("BodyColors") or item:IsA("Accessory") then
                               item:Clone().Parent = myChar
                           end
                       end

                       local myHum = myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                       if myHum then
                           pcall(function()
                               local desc = Players:GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId(targetPlayer.UserId)
                               if desc then myHum:ApplyDescription(desc) end
                           end)
                       end

                       pcall(function()
                           local avatarRemote = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("RE", true) and (ReplicatedStorage.RE:FindFirstChild("AvatarCustomization", true) or ReplicatedStorage.RE:FindFirstChild("UpdateSet", true))
                           if avatarRemote then avatarRemote:FireServer("WearOutfit", targetPlayer.UserId) end
                       end)
                   end
               end,
            })

            -- Tab 5: من نحن الكلاسيكي
            local AboutTab = Window:CreateTab(selectedLang == "AR" and "من نحن 👑" or "About Us 👑", 4483362458)

            AboutTab:CreateParagraph({
               Title = "👑 Owner & Developer | كـ,ـرآر | kـ,ـآرآرﯛتـ,ـو",
               Content = "مرحباً بك في الاصدار V31.0 المطور خصيصاً بواسطة كـ,ـرآر (@kararoottoo)!\n• الاصدار: V31.0\n• اللعبة: Brookhaven RP"
            })

            AboutTab:CreateButton({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "نسخ رابط حساب روبلوكس (kararoottoo) 👤" or "Copy Roblox Profile Link 👤",
               Callback = function()
                   setclipboard("https://www.roblox.com/users/kararoottoo/profile")
               end,
            })

            AboutTab:CreateButton({
               Name = selectedLang == "AR" and "نسخ رابط سيرفر الديسكورد 💬" or "Copy Discord Invite Link 💬",
               Callback = function()
                   setclipboard("https://discord.gg/WTmsZWHAB")
               end,
            })

            -- زر Shift Lock العائم
            local ShiftGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
            ShiftGui.Name = "AetherShiftLockV31"
            ShiftGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
            ShiftGui.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

            local LockBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
            LockBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 52, 0, 52)
            LockBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.2, 0)
            LockBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 30)
            LockBtn.Text = "🔒"
            LockBtn.TextSize = 26
            LockBtn.Parent = ShiftGui

            Instance.new("UICorner", LockBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
            local LockStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke", LockBtn)
            LockStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170)
            LockStroke.Thickness = 2

            local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos

            local function update(input)
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                LockBtn.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
            end

            LockBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragging = true
                    dragStart = input.Position
                    startPos = LockBtn.Position

                    input.Changed:Connect(function()
                        if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
                    end)
                end
            end)

            LockBtn.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    dragInput = input
                end
            end)

            UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if input == dragInput and dragging then update(input) end
            end)

            local shiftEnabled = false
            local shiftConn = nil

            LockBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                shiftEnabled = not shiftEnabled
                if shiftEnabled then
                    LockBtn.Text = "🔓"
                    LockStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 105, 180)
                    shiftConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
                        if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
                            local lookVector = Camera.CFrame.LookVector
                            LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position, LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(lookVector.X, 0, lookVector.Z))
                        end
                    end)
                else
                    LockBtn.Text = "🔒"
                    LockStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 170)
                    if shiftConn then shiftConn:Disconnect() shiftConn = nil end
                end
            end)

        else
            StatusLabel.Text = selectedLang == "AR" and "الرمز غير صحيح! حاول مرة أخرى ❌" or "Incorrect Key! Try Again ❌"
            StatusLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
        end
    end)
end

BtnAr.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    selectedLang = "AR"
    openKeySystem()
end)

BtnEn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    selectedLang = "EN"
    openKeySystem()
end)
